Questions?
Answers.

  • A sensor inside the cap measures the water level inside the bottle continuously. The difference in water level is used to calculate the amount of water consumed. 

  • The hydration goal is calculated based on individual parameters like Height, Weight, Activity Level, Gender, Temperature, etc. The methodology is described in this article. 

    Please treat the goal as just a recommendation and not a clinical obligation. Please feel free to modify the goal if required.

  • No subscription fee required for the app. All features of the app are free. Also we would never ruin your experience with Ads.

  • Yes, you can add hot water or ice in the bottle. Sipwise lite and classic have a single layer stainless steel body. Sipwise pro has a double layer build. This provides better thermal insulation and can maintain temperature for longer durations.

  • You can clean the bottle like a normal water bottle. The sensor system is fully sealed and safe. Although the USB C port is water resistant, it is not fully 'water proof'.  Sipwise Lite and Classic are not dishwasher safe, Sipwise Pro (coming soon) is dishwasher safe. 

    ​

    Make sure the USB C Port is dry before plugging in for charging.

  • This feature is coming soon :)
